text: The model flags CUST000719 as high‑risk, meaning its chance of leaving in the next ~9 months is well above the average customer. The main reasons are very low support satisfaction (1 / 5 versus a typical 3.3), a poor overall feedback rating (1 / 5 versus 3.2) and a short tenure of only 1 year compared with the usual 3.7 years. Protective factors are that the customer has a scored support ticket, came in through a referral, and belongs to the Student segment, which all tend to lower churn risk. Note: the model’s predictions are modest and should be used as a guide, not a certainty.
